## What lands — the core-surfaces acceptance battery (506 tests, read-only, `live_verification=false`)

- **`web/tests/e2e/acceptance.ts`** — shared helpers: emitted-file→route walk over `dist/`, the `<Figure>` region parser, the key-aware figure-pointer resolver (object keys → array indices → id-keyed row selection → row-document field descent → collection counts), the `dist/redirects.conf` rule parser, the ROUTES.csv loader.
- **Crawl** (`acceptance-crawl.spec.ts`, SIG-JUR-D08/D09, SIG-DSRC-D02) — every discovered route (477: T1 447 · T0 19 · T3 8 · T2 3) and every emitted non-HTML file answers 200; a never-published route answers the branded 404; slashless forms never answer different content; all 38 conf rules name a resolvable end-state and every stub-emitted historical URL serves its tombstone; no dossier page `<h1>` is a bare code/key/slug; no source id appears as visible prose outside the defined secondary-id contexts (`<code>`/`sig-mut`/figure-evidence labels/path locators).
- **Parity** (`acceptance-parity.spec.ts`, SIG-JUR-D06, SIG-DSRC-D08/D09) — every dossier HTML page agrees with its `.json` twin (h1, as-of, records figure); every sources-explorer row's cells equal its `sig.dossier-sources/1` twin entries (records, share, located/declared, claims, first/last seen, licence; withdrawn/upstream-disappeared/ingested rows carry the twin's honest state); a source's contribution reads identically on the dossier explorer and the source's own dossiers page; the grouped index's row numbers equal each twin's rollup.
- **Number truth** (`acceptance-number-truth.spec.ts`, J3 §5.4 / SIG-TRANSP-013) — all 5,150 figure regions across the emitted site: every `data-artifact` + `data-pointer` resolves; every numeric-leaf binding equals the rendered `data-figure-value`; every `data-figure-link="source"` anchor resolves (span-labelled markers recorded as in-page sources); every `#breakdown` anchor resolves in-page. Subject-bound and unserved-artifact classes are named, never silently skipped.
- **ROUTES.csv** (`acceptance-routes-csv.spec.ts`, COV-04) — a bijective disposition table over all 48 advertised 09-27 rows: `resolves` families emit, `retired` routes resolve through the one redirect generator, `internal` routes emit `internal:true` only (never public), `/task/` keeps its honest no-index answer, and bucket/API/intake URLs are `external` — owned by the promoted-release legs.
- **axe in both JS states** (`a11y-scripts-off.spec.ts`, SIG-UI-037) — WCAG 2.2 AA over every discovered route with every script refused at the network layer, beside the existing JS-on sweep; the `<noscript>` state notices' presence is asserted and their rendered visibility is covered by the no-js project.
- **Agent walkthroughs** (`acceptance-walkthroughs.spec.ts`, K13 §8) — A1 type→place ≤3 clicks, A2 deployed/approved/next-decision, A3 council print, A4 gap→task→draft, O1 county overview, O3 local list + CSV + licence, O4 gap→task→template, J1 figure→breakdown→recomputing rows — recorded **agent-verified**, never represented as user research.
- **A real binding fix the battery surfaced** — `HowWeKnowThis.astro`: the dsrc-scoped `hwkt-sources` figure named `/provenance_summary/source_independence_count`, a field `sig.dossier-sources/1` does not emit (it carries `sources_with_published_claims`, the same count `dossierSourcesProvenance` maps). The figure now names the field the artifact carries — rendered and pointed values identical by construction.
- **The Class S republish readout** — `docs/build/reports/p36.72a-acceptance/{READOUT.md,readout.json}` (`sig.core-surfaces-acceptance/1`): the evidence packet P36.72b's operator decision consumes.
